purpose: Preserve the current TinyFish Cloudflare activation boundary while binding the recovered read-only Shopify child-provider observation contract to present repository-provider truth without claiming live Shopify inventory, provider mutation, runtime activation, database mutation, merge authority, or deploy authority.

claims: `wrangler.worker.toml` must list `TINYFISH_API_KEY` under `[secrets].required`, so canonical exact-main Deploy rejects missing provider-held TinyFish activation before Worker mutation while never copying the secret value through GitHub Actions.
`README.md` must keep TinyFish source and CI readiness separate from provider/runtime activation and state that canonical Deploy verifies only provider-held binding-name presence before promotion.
`README.md` must describe Shopify child-provider observation as source-only, non-authorizing evidence and must never relabel a matching snapshot as live provider authority or mutation permission.

`docs/CLOUDFLARE_REASONING.md` must treat `TINYFISH_API_KEY` as a provider-held Worker binding and require canonical Deploy to fail closed on a missing binding name without exposing or re-uploading its value.

`docs/deployment/CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TARGETS.md` must name `TINYFISH_API_KEY` as a required canonical Worker secret while preserving live provider observation and real TinyFish Search/Fetch as separate activation proof.
`docs/SECRETS.md` must keep the TinyFish key in the Cloudflare Worker secret plane and never recast the provider-held value as a GitHub Actions secret or proof artifact.

`src/lib/providerObservation.ts` must classify child-provider evidence as current, undeclared, scope drift, identity drift, stale, or unknown without granting execution authority, and it must fail closed when observation freshness, completeness, declaration identity, or scope equality is not proven.

`src/providers/ShopifyReadOnlyProvider.ts` must bind Shopify observation to the exact Founder Control Room permanent and branded store identities, require complete pagination and app scope inventory, withhold CURRENT on incomplete or mismatched provider evidence, keep reconciliation non-authorizing, and never persist provider inventory or perform Shopify mutation.
